bytePreservation: All 573 PNG/WebP files are byte-identical and reuse existing URLs. Only the requested home GIF is replaced, copied byte-for-byte from the declared source asset. Character frames, atlases, simulation and audio are unchanged. The specified darkfan added claw cue is refined only by its renderer. Packaging never resizes or re-encodes assets; existing per-match loaders and retry UI remain.
limitations: Browser/network/device verification must be reported separately. Images are fetched when their existing loaders assign Image.src. All metadata stays synchronous. Audio remains its original inline base64.
